title: owehub
features:
THIS SCRIPT DONT WORK ON XENO OR SOLARA OR ANY LEVEL 3 EXEC

🔋 Stamina
Infinite Stamina (removes sprint stamina limit)
🌐 Network
Ghosting Mode (blocks position updates to server, makes you invisible to other players)
Lag Mode (alternates between ghosting and syncing every 2 seconds

🛡️ Status Effects
Avoid Slowness (blocks slowness debuff)
Avoid Hallucination (blocks hallucination effect)
Avoid Visual Effects (blocks blindness, glitched, subspaced effects)

🎯 Hitbox
Hitbox Expander (extends attack reach using velocity boost)
Hitbox Strength slider (10-100)

🔧 Auto Generator
Auto Generator Solver (automatically solves Flow puzzles)
Node Draw Speed (adjustable solve speed)
Delay Between Lines (adjustable pause between color paths)

👁️ ESP
ESP Killers (red highlight + name + health %)
ESP Survivors (yellow highlight + name + health %)
ESP Generators (orange highlight + progress %)
ESP Items (white highlight for BloxyCola & Medkit)
All ESP is always-on-top with billboard labels

🖥️ Interface
Spoof Usernames (replaces all username labels in UI)
Show Chat Logs (forces chat window to stay visible)
Timer Position (move round timer to Middle or Right)
